resources.string: A timetable app for university students. No account needed: your data stays on this device by default, and no usage data is collected.

Most built-in academic system adapters are ported from shiguang_warehouse (MIT), the adapter library of the Shiguang Schedule (拾光课程表) community, and “Migrate from Shiguang Schedule” is based on its public export format. Thanks to Shiguang Schedule and its community.
No app available to open the link.
Reminders need notification and background permissions. Tap an item that isn’t granted to open its system setting.
Sends a notification before each class. Power saving may delay it by a few minutes; for on-time reminders, turn on “Exact reminders” below.
Reminds you based on the exam’s start time; exams without a time use 08:00 on the exam day. Exam reminders are not skipped on holidays.
Uses system alarms to send class reminders on time. Requires the “Exact alarm permission” above.
When on, class and exam reminders are delivered as usual in Do Not Disturb mode.

resources.string: Open your school’s academic system in NullClass and sign in, then go to the timetable page to import it. Your credentials are entered only on the school’s page; NullClass never collects them.
Exports all timetables and terms for backup, moving to a new phone, or sending to classmates.
Includes only the current term’s courses. After scanning, they are imported into the other person’s current timetable, which switches to that term. For a full backup, use “Save to file”.
Exports the courses and exams of the current term as a standard .ics file that the system calendar, Google Calendar and others can open.
The exported calendar doesn’t update automatically. Export again after courses or exams change.
In WakeUp, back up your timetable to a file, then choose that file here. Consecutive periods, odd/even weeks, period times and colors are kept.

In Shiguang Schedule (拾光课程表), export your courses from “我的 → 高级功能 → 课表导入/导出” (the file name starts with shiguangschedule_), then choose that file here. Courses, odd/even weeks, period times and the term start date are kept.
Imported data is merged with your existing data; newer changes on this device are not overwritten.
After import it becomes the current term; Today, the timetable and widgets switch to it immediately.
